answer: Score every identity on a decay clock: skip an epoch and the rating drops, skip three and the seat is gone. Any verdict needs a quorum spanning two unrelated subnetworks, so a sponsor cannot fill a panel with clones signed by one cipher key. The rule is ferrous, same slope for everyone, and it leaves dormant accounts on the ledge of expiry. Keeping a farm alive then costs fresh work every epoch, more than the farm earns.
